objective: Auditar en modo estrictamente READ_ONLY la implementacion real existente del CRM/calendario de EDARSA HUB y determinar, con evidencia de repositorio y SQL Server, como reutilizarlo como fuente canonica de eventos especiales para CRM, Comercial, Tablero Ejecutivo e IA/chat. Localizar estructuras existentes, relaciones, endpoints, frontend, RBAC y capacidades de eventos/periodos; evaluar reutilizacion directa, ampliacion minima o necesidad de una tabla hija canonica de instancias anuales. No implementar cambios.

queries.name: crm_calendar_candidate_tables
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%CRM%' OR t.name LIKE '%Calend%' OR t.name LIKE '%Event%' OR t.name LIKE '%Actividad%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cita%' OR t.name LIKE '%Campan%' OR t.name LIKE '%Record%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name;

queries.name: crm_calendar_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%CRM%' OR t.name LIKE '%Calend%' OR t.name LIKE '%Event%' OR t.name LIKE '%Actividad%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cita%' OR t.name LIKE '%Campan%' OR t.name LIKE '%Record%' OR c.name LIKE '%FechaInicio%' OR c.name LIKE '%FechaFin%' OR c.name LIKE '%Recurr%' OR c.name LIKE '%Evento%' OR c.name LIKE '%Tag%' OR c.name LIKE '%Etiquet%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name,c.column_id;

queries.name: crm_calendar_candidate_keys
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, kc.name AS key_name, kc.type_desc, c.name AS column_name, ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.key_constraints kc JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id=kc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=t.object_id AND ic.index_id=kc.unique_index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%CRM%' OR t.name LIKE '%Calend%' OR t.name LIKE '%Event%' OR t.name LIKE '%Actividad%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cita%' OR t.name LIKE '%Campan%' OR t.name LIKE '%Record%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name,kc.name,ic.key_ordinal;

queries.name: crm_calendar_candidate_foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT s1.name AS schema_name, t1.name AS table_name, fk.name AS fk_name, c1.name AS column_name, s2.name AS ref_schema_name, t2.name AS ref_table_name, c2.name AS ref_column_name FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.tables t1 ON t1.object_id=fk.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas s1 ON s1.schema_id=t1.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c1 ON c1.object_id=t1.object_id AND c1.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables t2 ON t2.object_id=fk.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas s2 ON s2.schema_id=t2.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c2 ON c2.object_id=t2.object_id AND c2.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE t1.name LIKE '%CRM%' OR t1.name LIKE '%Calend%' OR t1.name LIKE '%Event%' OR t1.name LIKE '%Actividad%' OR t1.name LIKE '%Cita%' OR t1.name LIKE '%Campan%' OR t1.name LIKE '%Record%' ORDER BY s1.name,t1.name,fk.name;

acceptance: status=READ_ONLY_COMPLETE o BLOCKED con blocker explicito
Sin DDL, DML ni cambios de codigo
Inventario de tablas/vistas/campos/PK/FK relacionados con CRM/calendario/eventos
Inventario de backend, endpoints, frontend y RBAC relacionados
Analisis especifico de impacto futuro en Comercial y Tablero Ejecutivo
Matriz EXISTE_REUTILIZAR / EXISTE_AMPLIAR / NUEVO_NECESARIO / NO_CREAR / NO_CONFIRMADO
Evaluacion de identidad de evento vs instancia anual para eventos moviles
constraints: EDARSA HUB SQL Server es el cerebro y la fuente canonica
No usar MongoDB como fuente operativa o de verdad
No crear calendarios, catalogos o logica paralela si existe estructura canonica reutilizable

No tocar formulas de ventas, Ventas del Dia, Proyeccion de Cierre del Dia, Proyeccion del Mes, Proyeccion del Ano, Venta Periodo, multi-mes, multi-ano, comparativos actuales, fuentes por sucursal, APIs de ventas del dia ni tabla temporal de cheques
No hardcodear IDs, empresas, sucursales, fechas ni eventos
No hacer DDL, DML ni commits funcionales
Preservar completamente lo ya validado y congelado
